description: Na₄MgCr₂O₈ crystallizes in the triclinic P̅1 space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to five O atoms to form distorted edge-sharing NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.28-2.72 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.31-2.89 Å. Mg is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 2.08-2.34 Å. Cr is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Cr-O bond distances ranging from 1.66-1.80 Å. There are four inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na and one Cr atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Mg, and one Cr atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Mg, and one Cr atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Mg, and one Cr atom.
